about: UT1's web categories: the blacklists of Universite Toulouse 1 Capitole, under the Creative Commons licence CC BY-SA 4.0, fetched by the firewall itself; this project republishes none of them. A category's names are the DNS names of its domains file, counted on the day below; its bare IPv4 lines are left out, as DNS cannot use them. The labels and descriptions are this project's own words. Where approximate is true the count is not this project's: UT1's own page of 2026-10-08.

adult.name: Adult
adult.description: Adult sites, from erotic to pornographic.
adult.refused: about 4.6 million names, about 2.3 GiB held by Unbound's blocklist module: too much for a firewall
